issues.description: Startup script uses wrong port (8000) and wrong host (0.0.0.0). The correct startup method is via run_server.py which uses port 8001 and host 127.0.0.1 as expected by the frontend.
issues.impact: start_backend.bat will cause frontend-backend connection failures. Use run_server.py or update the bat file.
issues.recommendation: Update start_backend.bat to use --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 to match the working configuration.

issues.description: Finding model field names differ from conventional naming: uses 'resource_name' and 'resource_type' instead of 'resource' and 'service', and 'remediation' instead of 'recommendation'.
issues.impact: None - the model is complete and functional, just uses different field names.
issues.recommendation: No action required - field names are internally consistent and clearly documented.

summary: Core functionality verification complete. Backend is correctly configured for port 8001 and host 127.0.0.1 when launched via run_server.py. Frontend is correctly configured to connect to http://127.0.0.1:8001. All required endpoints exist. Demo Mode toggle, profile selection, region selector, and zero-findings messages are implemented. Mode labels accurately distinguish simulated vs live results. Finding model contains all required fields. One medium-severity issue: start_backend.bat uses incorrect port/host configuration.

startup_method.recommended: run_server.py or direct uvicorn command with --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001
